notes.title: 🎮 Join the Domination Playtest!
notes.content: [p]🎯 Domination on Office Map[/p][p]🗺️ Huge, multi-layered layout – explore vents up by the ceiling for sniper nests and weave between office desks with horizontal & vertical partitions.[/p][p]⚔️ 3 control points – one in the center, one near your spawn, one near theirs. Hold ’em to score points and pull your team ahead.[/p][p]🚀 Fast-paced team play – constant skirmishes over each point make every second count.[/p][p]==============================[/p][p]🔥 Warehouse “Floor Is Lava”[/p][p]📦 Crate pyramid – climb higher as lava rises, but watch out: the higher you go, the tighter it gets.[/p][p]🌋 Rising danger – lava forces you to keep moving or get trapped below.[/p][p]⏳ High-tension chaos – perfect for quick rounds and last-survivor bragging rights.[/p][p]👉 Give both modes a spin and tell us what needs tweaking! [/p][p][/p][p]Check this out: we’re dropping Domination on the Office map—which is massive compared to anything we’ve shown before. [/p][p][/p][p]It’s multi-layered so you can scope out sniper nests in the vents up by the ceiling, weave through office desks with partitions that slice the map both horizontally and vertically into tight combat compounds. [/p][p][/p][p]You’ve got three control points—one smack in the middle, one near your spawn, and one over by theirs—two teams duking it out in a pure adrenaline rush. [/p][p][/p][p]And then, just to crank the hype, we’ve got Warehouse “Floor Is Lava.” [/p][p][/p][p]Picture a pyramid of boxes, like a tree of crates and the lava’s creeping up, so the higher you climb, the less real estate you’ve got. [/p][p][/p][p]From our, devs point of view, Domination is better. [/p][p]Still, we’d love for you to tear into both modes and let us know what needs tweaking. Bring the heat.[/p]
